description:
Construction price index for residential buildings. Source: Bundesbank.

Quarterly data (2015=100).

Parameters:
- start/end: YYYY-MM-DD
- recent: number of most recent periods

Key response fields (German names):
- preisindex: construction price index
- preisindex_delta_1q: change vs. previous quarter
- preisindex_delta_1j: change vs. previous year
name: macro_construction_prices
title: Construction Prices
